audit: Independent isolated one-hop dictionary crossreference candidate audit
scope: Isolated candidate resolver and its tests only; no production integration, contextual ranking, frontend behavior or deployment approval
checks: All 16 supporting source and target entry objects equal the corresponding original downloaded JSONL objects; every original raw line hash matches.

All 64 returned supporting claims bind a complete wrapper whose SHA-256 matches the accepted parent hash after the original json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) serialization. Final source relation claims must share the headword/morphology binding, including source URL and hashes.
Complete source sense objects, including links, match their hash-bound raw parent senses. Source form arrays, headwords, POS and head templates match the same parent record.
All 25 candidate gloss arrays equal literal accepted target sense quotes. No generated gloss, target morphological analysis, contextual selection or inferred source spelling was observed.
Exact NFC target-headword matches retain distinct entry IDs, etymology numbers, POS labels and source-target pair identities. Case, accents and letters are not folded.
Form-page targets stop at one hop. Source relations and terminal/no-safe-sense states remain inspectable instead of receiving invented definitions.

Independent adversarial checks rejected changed source-relation parent hash, source URL and wrapper hash; coordinated target gloss/source-sense/quote tampering could not override the retained parent record; a duplicate target wrapper removed only that target.

python -m pytest tests/test_dictionary_crossrefs.py -q: 16 passed, including source form/link tampering, missing proof, target headword tampering, duplicate identity, no accent folding, nonrecursive termination and no network requirement.

Backend reference search found no production importer/caller of lookup_crossreference_meanings. The adapter uses local indexes and a read-only source SQLite connection; no paid or network call is added.

examples.note: Both territory/people senses and the separate plant etymology remain distinct unselected alternatives.
This is a dictionary candidate for the source-listed numeral form, not adjudication of a particular πέμπων occurrence.
Adjective and noun target entries stay separate; POS disagreement is disclosed.
Four source-target pair identities retained despite identical gloss text.

limitations: A page link does not choose an etymology, POS section or sense. Candidates must remain alternatives unless separately adjudicated; this PASS does not validate the plant interpretation for a δᾶμον occurrence.
Source retrieval inherits the existing 20-source-entry bound. All exact target entries retrieved by the local adapter are retained; this does not establish unlimited source recall.
Whole-sense English-preview exclusions from the lexical variant helper can omit mixed-language or multiline source material.
The projection trusts accepted claim hashes as the local provenance root. This audit reverified the retained source bytes; the runtime adapter does not rehash entire upstream files on every query.
Upstream machine-extracted-unreviewed quality and licensing qualifications remain unchanged.
mutations: Only this new audit report was written; frozen C/D/E artifacts and previous audits were not modified. No runtime code, source data, integration or deployment changed by auditor.
